nativeProtocol: Actual launcher VICE Turbo6510 PALx64,safe,Colodore/filter0,silent fixtures,sound off.128simulation-event warm-up;2048tick moving route. Count complete newly rendered swaps only. Commands/logs/native frame timestamps/start-end RAM retained externally. No host/warp/CPU replay FPS.
poseProtocol: Same frozen inputs;3completed views then park main CPU in existing self-JMP while IRQ/VIC complete3PAL raster0events. No code/framebuffer modifications. Correctness capture only, never FPS.
